units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 5:5">Keth. V, 5</cite> <he>הב׳ מביאה וכ׳</he> idleness leads to immorality.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:4">Ab. III, 4</cite> <he>המפנה לבו לב׳</he> who turns his mind to vanities.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:1:10">Y. Ber. VI, 10ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>להזכיר ש״ש לב׳</he> to pronounce the name of the Lord for no purpose.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 7:5:4">Y. Keth. VII, 31ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>דברים של ב׳</he> useless labors (as carrying water and pouring it out again).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:10">Gen. R. s. 91</cite> <he>דבר של ב׳</he> irrelevant argument.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 4:4:5">Y. Naz. IV, 53ᵇ</cite> <he>על הב׳</he> for no use.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 16b:11">Kidd. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>שכר ב׳</he> compensation for interrupted labor; a. fr.
